metas.name: Gladiator II
metas.description: After his home is conquered by the tyrannical emperors who now lead Rome, Lucius is forced to enter the Colosseum and must look to his past to find strength to return the glory of Rome to its people.

metas.name: The Ring
metas.description: A journalist must investigate a mysterious videotape which seems to cause the death of anyone one week to the day after they view it.

metas.name: Jaws
metas.description: When a massive killer shark unleashes chaos on a beach community off Long Island, it's up to the local police chief, a marine biologist, and an old seafarer to hunt the beast down.

metas.name: Coco
metas.description: Aspiring musician Miguel, confronted with his family's ancestral ban on music, enters the Land of the Dead to find his great-great-grandfather, a legendary singer.

metas.name: Hellraiser
metas.description: A woman discovers the newly resurrected, partially formed, body of her brother-in-law and lover. She starts killing for him to revitalize his body and escape the demonic beings that are pursuing him after he escaped their underworld.

metas.name: Reservoir Dogs
metas.description: When a simple jewelry heist goes horribly wrong, the surviving criminals begin to suspect that one of them is a police informant.

metas.name: Crazy Rich Asians
metas.description: This contemporary romantic comedy based on a global bestseller follows native New Yorker Rachel Chu to Singapore to meet her boyfriend's family.

metas.name: The Lord of the Rings: The Two Towers
metas.description: While Frodo and Sam edge closer to Mordor with the help of the shifty Gollum, the divided fellowship makes a stand against Sauron's new ally, Saruman, and his hordes of Isengard.

metas.name: The Last House on the Left
metas.description: After kidnapping and brutally assaulting two young women, a gang unknowingly finds refuge at a vacation home belonging to the parents of one of the victims: a mother and father who devise an increasingly gruesome series of revenge...

metas.name: Batman: Knightfall - Part 1: Knightfall
metas.description: When the mysterious behemoth known only as Bane frees Batman's entire rogue's gallery from Arkham Asylum, the Caped Crusader is pushed to his mental and physical breaking point.

metas.name: Braveheart
metas.description: Scottish warrior William Wallace leads his countrymen in a rebellion to free his homeland from the tyranny of King Edward I of England.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description: The true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered the massive scandal of child molestation and cover-up within the local Catholic Archdiocese, shaking the entire Catholic Church to its core.

metas.name: Tombstone
metas.description: A successful lawman's plans to retire anonymously in Tombstone, Arizona, are disrupted by the kind of outlaws he was famous for eliminating.

metas.name: The Blair Witch Project
metas.description: Three film students vanish after traveling into a Maryland forest to film a documentary on the local Blair Witch legend, leaving only their footage behind.

metas.name: Argo
metas.description: Acting under the cover of a Hollywood producer scouting a location for a science fiction film, a CIA agent launches a dangerous operation to rescue six Americans in Tehran during the U.S. hostage crisis in Iran in 1979.

metas.name: Coherence
metas.description: Strange things begin to happen when a group of friends gather for a dinner party on an evening when a comet is passing overhead.

metas.name: When Harry Met Sally...
metas.description: Harry and Sally have known each other for years, and are very good friends, but they fear sex would ruin the friendship.

metas.name: Roofman
metas.description: A charismatic criminal, while on the run from the police, hides in a hidden space of a toy store. There, he adopts a new identity and becomes involved with an employee, beginning a relationship as unlikely as it is risky.

metas.name: They Live
metas.description: They influence our decisions without us knowing it. They numb our senses without us feeling it. They control our lives without us realizing it. They live.

metas.name: A Quiet Place

metas.name: If I Had Legs I'd Kick You
metas.description: While trying to manage her own life and career, a woman on the verge of a breakdown must cope with her daughter's illness, an absent husband, a missing person, and an unusual relationship with her therapist.

metas.name: Amadeus
metas.description: The life and work of Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart seen through the eyes of his contemporary and rival, Antonio Salieri.

metas.name: Split
metas.description: Three girls are kidnapped by a man with a diagnosed 23 distinct personalities. They must try to escape before the apparent emergence of a frightful new 24th.

metas.name: The Equalizer
metas.description: A man who believes he has put his mysterious past behind him cannot stand idly by when he meets a young girl under the control of ultra-violent Russian gangsters.

metas.name: Little Women
metas.description: In 19th century Massachusetts, the March sisters--Meg, Jo, Beth, and Amy--on the threshold of womanhood, go through many ups and downs in life and endeavor to make important decisions about their futures.

metas.name: Shang-Chi and the Legend of the Ten Rings
metas.description: Shang-Chi, the master of weaponry-based Kung Fu, is forced to confront his past after being drawn into the Ten Rings organization.

metas.name: Karate Kid: Legends
metas.description: After kung fu prodigy Li Fong relocates to New York City, he attracts unwanted attention from a local karate champion and embarks on a journey to enter the ultimate karate competition with the help of Mr. Han and Daniel LaRusso.

metas.name: Grease
metas.description: Good girl Sandy Olsson and greaser Danny Zuko fell in love over the summer. When they unexpectedly discover they're now in the same high school, will they be able to rekindle their romance?

metas.name: Superbad
metas.description: Two co-dependent high school seniors are forced to deal with separation anxiety after their plan to stage a booze-soaked party goes awry.

metas.name: Pet Sematary
metas.description: After tragedy strikes, a grieving father discovers an ancient burial ground behind his home with the power to raise the dead.

metas.name: Tropic Thunder
metas.description: Through a series of freak occurrences, a group of actors shooting a big-budget war movie are forced to become the soldiers they are portraying.

metas.name: Jungle
metas.description: A group of friends joins a guide for a trek into the Bolivian jungle, searching for an Indian village. The men soon realize that the jungle is a difficult place to be.

metas.name: A Knight's Tale
metas.description: After his master dies, a peasant squire, fueled by his desire for food and glory, creates a new identity for himself as a knight.

metas.name: People We Meet on Vacation
metas.description: Poppy wants to explore the world and Alex prefers to stay home with a good book, but somehow they are the very best of friends. They live far apart, but for a decade they have spent one week of summer vacation together.

metas.name: Anatomy of a Fall
metas.description: A woman is suspected of murder after her husband's death; their half-blind son faces a moral dilemma as the main witness.

metas.name: Bring It On
metas.description: A champion high school cheerleading squad discovers its previous captain stole all their best routines from an inner-city school and must scramble to compete at this year's championships.

metas.name: Casablanca
metas.description: A cynical expatriate American cafe owner struggles to decide whether or not to help his former lover and her fugitive husband escape the Nazis in French Morocco.

metas.name: Toy Story 2
metas.description: When Woody is stolen by a toy collector, Buzz and his friends set out on a rescue mission to save Woody before he becomes a museum toy property with his roundup gang Jessie, Prospector, and Bullseye.

metas.name: Love Actually
metas.description: Follows the lives of eight very different couples in dealing with their love lives in various loosely interrelated tales all set during a frantic month before Christmas in London, England.

metas.name: Mad Max: Fury Road
metas.description: In a post-apocalyptic wasteland, a woman rebels against a tyrannical ruler in search for her homeland with the aid of a group of female prisoners, a psychotic worshipper and a drifter named Max.

metas.name: Jack Reacher: Never Go Back
metas.description: Jack Reacher must uncover the truth behind a major government conspiracy in order to clear his name while on the run as a fugitive from the law.

metas.name: Dream Scenario
metas.description: An ordinary family man finds his life turned upside down when strangers suddenly start seeing him in their dreams.

metas.name: Her
metas.description: In the near future, a lonely writer develops an unlikely relationship with an operating system designed to meet his every need.

metas.name: Ready Player One
metas.description: When the creator of a virtual reality called the OASIS dies, he makes a posthumous challenge to all OASIS users to find his Easter Egg, which will give the finder his fortune and control of his world.

metas.name: Ted

metas.name: The Help

metas.name: We Live in Time

metas.name: The Conjuring: Last Rites
metas.description: Paranormal investigators Ed and Lorraine Warren take on one last terrifying case involving mysterious entities they must confront.

metas.name: Don't Look Up

metas.name: The Accountant

metas.name: Once Upon a Time in America

metas.name: Zootopia 2
metas.description: Brave rabbit cop Judy Hopps and her friend, the fox Nick Wilde, team up again to crack a new case, the most perilous and intricate of their careers.

metas.name: Ford v Ferrari
metas.description: American car designer Carroll Shelby and driver Ken Miles battle corporate interference and the laws of physics to build a revolutionary race car for Ford in order to defeat Ferrari at the 24 Hours of Le Mans in 1966.

metas.name: Pitch Perfect

metas.name: Black Widow
metas.description: Natasha Romanoff confronts the darker parts of her ledger when a dangerous conspiracy with ties to her past arises.

metas.name: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
metas.description: Harry Potter, Ron and Hermione return to Hogwarts School of Witchcraft and Wizardry for their third year of study, where they delve into the mystery surrounding an escaped prisoner who poses a dangerous threat to the young wizard.

metas.name: The Lion King

metas.name: Twister

metas.name: Perfect Days
metas.description: Hirayama cleans public toilets in Tokyo, lives his life in simplicity and daily tranquility. Some encounters also lead him to reflect on himself.

metas.name: Black Hawk Down
metas.description: The story of one hundred and sixty elite U.S. soldiers who dropped into Mogadishu in October 1993 to capture two top lieutenants of a renegade warlord, but found themselves in a desperate battle with a large force of heavily armed...

metas.name: The Dink
metas.description: A washed-up tennis pro tries to save a club by reluctantly playing pickleball to earn his father's respect.

metas.name: Halloween

metas.name: The Man in the Iron Mask

metas.name: ParaNorman

metas.name: Raiders of the Lost Ark

metas.name: The Wild Robot
metas.description: A sentient robot stranded on an uninhabited island raises an orphaned gosling while trying to fit in with the local wildlife.

metas.name: Bullet Train

metas.name: Gerald's Game

metas.name: Babylon

metas.name: Final Destination

metas.name: Lock, Stock and Two Smoking Barrels

metas.name: The Fifth Element

metas.name: Underworld

metas.name: The Fast and the Furious

metas.name: The Idea of You

metas.name: The Lives of Others
metas.description: In 1984 East Berlin, an agent of the secret police conducting surveillance on a writer and his lover finds himself becoming increasingly absorbed by their lives.

metas.name: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair

metas.name: Exit 8

metas.name: Dungeons & Dragons: Honor Among Thieves

metas.name: Videodrome

metas.name: Alice in Wonderland

metas.name: The Irishman

metas.name: Margin Call

metas.name: An American Werewolf in London

metas.name: American Gangster

metas.name: Almost Famous

metas.name: Don't Say Good Luck

metas.name: Doctor Strange in the Multiverse of Madness

metas.name: Inferno

metas.name: Train to Busan

metas.name: Training Day

metas.name: Outlander

metas.name: Resident Evil: Apocalypse

metas.name: Saw

metas.name: Jumanji: Welcome to the Jungle

metas.name: The Order

metas.name: You've Got Mail
